headline: Woman's dismembered body parts recovered from Adabor canal
summary: Police recovered the head and hand of an unidentified woman from a canal in Dhaka's Adabor area on Saturday afternoon.
details: Police recovered the dismembered body parts of an unidentified woman from a canal in the Adabor area of the capital city.
The recovered parts, which included the head and a hand, were found in sacks on Saturday afternoon at the Hakkarpar canal in Adabor 10.
According to police, the identity of the woman has not yet been established.
Police are continuing their efforts to recover any remaining body parts of the victim.
The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) team has been informed and has been called in to assist in identifying the woman.
caption:

The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) team has been informed and has been called in to assist in identifying the woman.

headline: 1,019 dead as measles outbreak kills 7 in 24 hours
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a surge in measles cases, with five of the recent deaths occurring in Dhaka.
details: Seven people died from measles symptoms in the last 24 hours, according to a press release from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS). Of these, five deaths were recorded in Dhaka.
Since March 15 of this year, the total number of suspected measles cases in Bangladesh has reached 170,638. Out of these, 20,068 cases have been laboratory-confirmed.
The health department reports that 150,202 patients had to be hospitalized during this period, while 144,885 have been discharged after recovering.
The total death toll from measles and measles-like symptoms since March 15 has now reached 1,019.
This represents a massive spike compared to previous years. In 2025, there were only 132 cases, and no deaths were recorded in 2024, 2023, or 2022.
